story.heading: The story behind your resume
story.intro: t.ROY's reading of the work you gave us. You decide whether this sounds like you.
story.draftNote: Story draft: its fact check is incomplete. Your resume and saved corrections are still here. Check the story before exporting it.
story.firstDraft: This is your first stronger draft. In the Refinery, you can sharpen the story, tailor the resume to a real job and practice saying it with confidence.
story.revisit: Change what t.ROY should lead with
story.directions: Possible directions and your next steps
story.checkLinesBody: {count, plural, =1 {This line} other {These lines}} may say more about a card, license or certification than you told us. If you hold it, you can ignore this. If you don't, don't tell an employer you do.
story.barriersTitle: Work through hurdles in the Refinery
story.barriersBody: Your resume stays focused on your work. In the Refinery, t.ROY helps you prepare what to say about your record, consider the job and employer, and practice the conversation in your own words. You can also find local support.
story.flagged: You flagged: {list}. Those are topics to work through, not a judgment about what you can do.
story.disclaimer: Disclosure guidance is career coaching, not legal advice.
story.print: Print or save your story as a PDF
story.popupAlert: Please allow popups for this site to save the PDF.

pdf.subtitle: Your Forge Analysis from Steel Man Resumes
pdf.planner: Use the Disclosure Planner with t.ROY to prepare what to say and compare the requirements of a real job. This is coaching, not legal advice.
pdf.privateBody: This analysis is for your own use as you plan your next steps. It speaks candidly about your situation, barriers, and resources, so keep it for yourself. Your resume and cover letter are the documents to share with employers.
pdf.footerPrint: File › Print › Save as PDF to download

off.label: Leave it off the page
off.body: These jobs and their duties stay out of this resume. Your saved source keeps them. You can revisit this choice for a different job.

state.label: Show the work, name the state
state.body: The job stays. The employer reads as the state, not the facility.

facility.label: Name the facility as I wrote it
facility.body: Everything stays the way you wrote it.

recordChoice.title: Your record on this page
recordChoice.intro: Some of your work happened inside. You decide how it shows. Nothing about a record gets added either way.
recordChoice.radioAria: How your inside work shows on the page
recordChoice.previewFacility: On the page as you wrote it
recordChoice.rebuilding: Rebuilding your documents with that choice...

grounding.tailOpen: Read these closely before you send anything.
grounding.tailDone: The check can also reword lines it didn't flag. Read it once before you send it. You know your history best.
